summary: The reel effectively uses flat 2D character assets and environments to tell the story of a tense mate situation with family. Character hand placement on gourds, passing mechanics, and text overlays generally follow the checklist, though some text box crowding and minor expression repetitions occur.

clean: Shot 0-2, 5: Mother-in-law passing the mate with correct hand grips on the sides.
Shot 4: Close-up of smoking mate with bombilla and warning label shows clear proportional scaling.
Shot 7-8: Character drinking with bombilla at mouth and hand securely grasping the gourd.
unclean: Shot 10: Girlfriend looks worried/sad but her hands remain oddly stiff at her sides while the text mentions lack of help.

clean: Consistent flat 2D art style, proper couch and window background proportions relative to characters.
Clear visual progression from the passing scene to options and family reactions.
unclean: Shot 1-2: Multiple family members clustered closely at the bottom with overlapping label boxes that slightly crowd the view.

issues.problem: Girlfriend expression and stance do not emphasize the lack of help clearly enough.
issues.fix: Add a shoulder shrug or open palm gesture to match the 'sin ayuda' text.

learnings.rule: Maintain the correct side-grasping grip for all characters holding gourds across all frames.
Avoid overlapping multiple caption boxes when several family members are grouped together in a single frame.
